quality_intent: Relax anti-duplication strictness enough to support commercially useful spaced-practice variation, while preserving source correctness, second-class scope, answer integrity and meaningful cognitive distinctness.

authoritative_source.scope_rule: Use only second-class-applicable material. Subsections explicitly marked 〔一等〕 remain prohibited. Supporting statutes or MLIT pages may verify a guide proposition but may not create an exam proposition absent from the guide.

same_core_proposition_variants.rule: The same core source proposition may support multiple questions only when each additional question tests a materially different decision, application, exception, misconception, or reasoning route. Wording-only repetition remains prohibited.

distinctness_gate.new_rule: shared core proposition is permitted when the tested decision boundary is materially different
distinctness_gate.minimum_distinctness: Each variant after the first must differ from every accepted family member on at least two controlled axes, and at least one differing axis must be cognitive rather than cosmetic.
controlled_axes: aircraft or flight-method applicability explicitly distinguished by the source
scenario facts that change the required judgment

review_throughput.note: Independent reviewer still evaluates every candidate; this relaxation reduces governance prose, not answer-quality checks.

batch_size.reason: Larger batches reduce transaction overhead while keeping collision review tractable.

portfolio_quality_controls.stop_rule: If 400 cannot be reached without violating the quality floor or controlled-variant limits, stop below 400 and persist the source ceiling rather than fabricate filler.

target_distribution_guidance.allowed_deviation: Prefer source-supported balance; exact 100/100/100/100 is not required.

prohibited: distractors that are arguably correct under the stem
more than three questions in one core proposition family
same scenario with only nouns/numbers shuffled
backfilling low-value items solely to hit 400

execution_plan.objective: Integrate and source-verify the already accepted eight Operations candidates as Q189-Q196.
Decompose the guide by domain, core proposition family, boundary/exception, misconception and reasoning path; author 25-40 candidates per batch under the controlled-variant rules.
After each batch passes independent review and Director gate, allocate IDs, integrate canonical drafts and source-verify without waiting for all 400.

When 400 accepted, source-verified canonical questions exist, execute one explicit release activation, preserve historical first-use revision evidence, regenerate runtime and app assets, and run full release gates.

preserved_invariants: DRONE-Q-000001..DRONE-Q-000188 keep their existing identity, content and release history.
The currently released 188-question runtime remains unchanged until a later activation gate.
The existing 20-question free selection remains unchanged unless separately decided.
The immutable V0 100-question validation snapshot remains unchanged.
